text_block_list.text:
One day, I saw Biko Pegasus and the others
at the cafeteria. Across their table sat
a vast spread of dishes, and—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! This is the
'Full of Nutrition! Rapid Growth Club,' you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll gobble it all up and grow big and strong!
Then I'll become a magnificent great witch—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this stir-fry...
It has bell peppers in it?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Vitamins and carotene! They're packed with essential nutrients for a great witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-What a Great Witch needs...!!
~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: NO WAY AFTER ALLLLLL!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It's definitely gonna taste super bitter!
There's no way I can swallow it!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huuuhm...
I really need to do something about my weak points, huh.
choice_data_list: To hide the taste of the bell peppers, or something?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: !! That's it!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Is this... sauce poured over the bell peppers?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: My big sister taught me how to make it before! The strong flavor masks the bitterness!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. ...Smells nice...
With this—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't after all!!
Even without eating, that taste... is still in my mouth...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Noooooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Stupid, stupid bell peppers! How dare you get in my way!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I am a future Great Witch!
So why... why this...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's too early to give up!
Gather your courage and take that first step!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Biko...!
...Don't make it sound so easy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Like it's that easy! Just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! This smell...!
I really can't get used to it...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that milk!?
Don't tell me...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Phaaaah! How's that?!
This is my first step!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-Why go that far...?!
You're supposed to hate milk, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to be one!
A big, cool hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of things I'm not good at too. But...
my desire to become a hero is much stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You must feel the same way! That's why
you're struggling so hard with not being able to eat bell peppers!
Because you don't want to give up...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then—all that's left is to take that first step!
Don't worry. You're not alone.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: A hero never abandons their friends—nor a future Great Witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hmph!
Who do you think you are, trying to look all cool!
Forcing yourself to chug milk like that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm a future grand witch!
Eating green peppers...
is nothing to me!!
choice_data_list: The power of feelings is the strongest there is!
The power of feelings is the strongest, you know!
Alright, let's head back and get eating, shall we?
Let's head right back to eating.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm a future grand witch!
Eating green peppers...
is nothing to me!!
choice_data_list: The power of feelings is the strongest there is!
The power of feelings is the strongest, you know!
Alright, let's head back and get eating, shall we?
Let's head right back to eating.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, this ain't all I've got!
I'll grow bigger and become even more of a hero!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...*munch munch*—*gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Gotta strike while both the passion and the food are hot!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...*munch munch*—*gulp*.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's so biiiitter!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, this sauce isn't enough!
Make it richer next time, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Challenge accepted!
Next time, I'll really make Sweep roar with power!
